raw_segments.text: Lear, meantime, we shall express our darker purpose.
Know that we have divided in three our kingdom, and tease our fast intent to shake all cares
and business from our age, conferring them on younger strengths, while we unburdened
Our son of Cornwall, and you, our no less loving son of Albany, we have this hour a
constant will to publish our daughters several dowers.
That future strife may be prevented now.
The princes, France, and Burgundy, great rivals in our youngest daughters' love, long
in our court have made their amorous sojourn, and here are to be.
Tell me, my daughters, since now we will divest us both of rule, interest of territory, cares
Which of you shall we say doth love us most?
That we our largest bounty may extend where nature doth with merit challenge.
Goneril, our eldest born, speak first.
